newsitem.title: UK: Rothschilds poised to announce shake up - paper.
newsitem.headline: Rothschilds poised to announce shake up - paper.

text.p: The Rothschild banking dynasty is expected to announced a major reorganisation as part of a move to integrate its world-wide businesses, the Independent newspaper said on Tuesday.

This will involve the establishment of a new investment banking committee, chaired by Baron David de Rothschild. It will cordinate the family's corporate finance business in London, Paris, the rest of continental Europe, Hong Kong, Singapore, Australia, North America and Latin America, the paper said.
The Independent said the move makes David de Rothschild favourite to succeed Sir Evelyn de Rothschild as chairman of NM Rothschild, the London merchant bank.
David de Rothschild will also become chairman of a newly established company in London called NM Rothschild Corporate Finance, the paper added.
It said there were also plans to give a clearer identity to all the banking businesses in the Rothschild empire owned by the family's Swiss holding company Rothschild Continuation Holdings.
The balance sheets of the individual businesses would eventually be published on a group wide basis, it added.
